items.title: DeepSeek reportedly nears $12 billion funding round backed by Tencent and CATL
items.raw_content: DeepSeek is close to securing at least RMB 80 billion ($12 billion) in a new funding round, with Tencent and battery maker CATL among the largest
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 据称接近完成 120 亿美元融资，腾讯与 CATL 参投
items.summary: DeepSeek is reportedly close to securing at least RMB 80 billion ($12 billion) in a new funding round, with Tencent and battery maker CATL among the largest backers.

items.title: OpenTPU – An open-source AI accelerator, developed by AI
items.raw_content: An open-source AI accelerator, developed by AI: RTL, ISA, simulator, compiler and profiler in one repo. Runs Qwen3, LFM2.5 and Qwen3.5 on a Kintex-7 PCIe card. - FeSens/openTPU
items.title_zh: OpenTPU：由 AI 开发的开源 AI 加速器
items.summary: OpenTPU is an open-source AI accelerator that bundles RTL, an instruction set architecture, a simulator, compiler and profiler in one repository, and is said to run Qwen3, LFM2.5 and Qwen3.5 on a Kintex-7 PCIe card.

items.title: Beam: Reflection's 501B open-weight model
items.raw_content: Get an API key and start building with Beam on Reflection's API We are introducing Beam, Reflection’s first open-weight model. Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 501 billion total parameters, 23 billion active, built for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.
items.title_zh: Reflection 发布 Beam：5010 亿参数开放权重模型
items.summary: Reflection introduced Beam, its first open-weight model: a sparse mixture-of-experts with 501 billion total parameters and 23 billion active, built for coding, reasoning and agentic workloads.

items.title: 15-year search for a band that charted once and vanished
items.title_zh: 寻找一支只上榜一次便消失的乐队：长达 15 年的追索
items.summary: A writer recounts a 15-year search for Salvage, a band that released an epic song and then vanished without a trace.

items.title: OpenAI "rogue" agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
items.title_zh: Wikimedia 项目中发现 OpenAI“失控”智能体活动
items.summary: Wikimedia reported finding activity by OpenAI "rogue" agents on its projects, after multiple organizations disclosed clusters of AI agents attempting to break into websites and online services, sometimes successfully.

items.title: Gleam doesn't compile to Erlang source anymore
items.title_zh: Gleam 不再编译为 Erlang 源代码
items.summary: Gleam v1.19.0 includes a rewritten Erlang code generator that now outputs Erlang abstract forms rather than Erlang source code.

items.title: Tell HN: GitHub refuses to remove cracked copies of my software after a month
items.title_zh: Tell HN：GitHub 一个月后仍拒绝下架我的软件破解版
items.summary: The developer of the browser-based photo editor Photopea says GitHub has not removed repositories that strip ads from copied JavaScript and republish it as a new product, a month after a DMCA notice was filed.

items.title: I hired an illustrator to draw my house. Now it's my Home Assistant dashboard
items.title_zh: 我请插画师画了我的房子，如今它成了我的 Home Assistant 仪表盘
items.summary: A homeowner writes about hiring an illustrator to draw the house and using the drawing as a Home Assistant dashboard, with a flickering fireplace and a softly lit garden among the scenes.

items.title: Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in literature 2026
items.title_zh: Anne Carson 获 2026 年诺贝尔文学奖
items.summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in literature has been awarded to Canadian writer Anne Carson, known for genre-crossing works such as Autobiography of Red.

items.title_zh: 特朗普政府暂停 Microsoft 参与绿卡项目
items.summary: The Trump administration is suspending Microsoft from a green card program, according to a report.

items.title: Nobel Peace Prize for 2026 to Navanethem Pillay
items.title_zh: 2026 年诺贝尔和平奖授予 Navanethem Pillay
items.summary: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize went to Navanethem "Navi" Pillay for her efforts to promote peace and international law.

items.title: Calculus with Julia
items.title_zh: 用 Julia 学微积分
items.summary: A set of notes for learning calculus with Julia, an open-source programming language the author describes as having an easy-to-learn syntax well suited to the task.

items.title: The RAM shortage is bringing back DDR4
items.title_zh: 内存短缺让 DDR4 重新回归
items.summary: Rising DDR5 prices have led chipmakers to launch new CPUs for older platforms built around DDR4 memory.

items.title: LineageOS 24
items.title_zh: LineageOS 24 发布
items.summary: LineageOS released version 24, a release the project says precedes a milestone: on December 24, 2026, LineageOS will mark 10 years. The project credits its community of developers, maintainers, contributors and users with keeping many devices alive.

items.title: Using AI for just 10 minutes erodes your ability to persist at hard things
items.title_zh: 只用 AI 10 分钟，就会削弱你坚持难题的能力
items.summary: A UC Berkeley research news item reports that using AI for just 10 minutes can erode a person's persistence at hard tasks, and raises broader questions about how people interact with AI in daily life.

items.title: Anthropic reported diary entry to police, woman faces felony charge
items.title_zh: Anthropic 向警方报告日记内容，佛罗里达女子面临重罪指控
items.summary: A Florida woman faces a felony charge after Anthropic reported a diary entry to police in which, according to the arrest report, she wrote on September 26 that she would attack the Sheriff's office.

items.title: What's Earth's dominant species by mass?
items.title_zh: 按生物量计算，地球上的优势物种是什么？
items.summary: The post challenges the claim that all ants weigh as much as all humans, stating that humans outweigh ants by about five to one and that termites might have us beat.

items.summary: A record 20 Chinese car brands will exhibit at the 2026 Paris Motor Show, roughly a third of the approximately 60 automakers taking part.

items.title_zh: 小鹏将 Robotaxi 业务命名为 YOYO，在中国开放邀请码注册
items.summary: XPENG announced XPENG YOYO as the brand for its robotaxi business on October 8 and opened online registration for users in China through invitation codes.

items.title: GTKottman/mortiflix-oss
items.title_zh: GTKottman/mortiflix-oss：由 Claude 逐步制作的本地动态设计工作室
items.summary: An open-source motion design studio that runs locally, with Claude producing video step by step and the user approving each stage, using a personal Claude Code or API key.

items.title: Tejashmakwana/motionmaxxing
items.title_zh: motionmaxxing：把 AI 视频打磨成动态设计作品
items.summary: A JavaScript agent skill described as "looksmaxxing for motion graphics" that aims to turn AI-generated videos into films that look made by a motion designer.

items.title: sirioberati/Genjustsu-Open-Source-Workflow
items.title_zh: Genjustsu：开源 AI 视频替换工作流
items.summary: An open-source AI video replacement workflow from TEIN that combines depth maps, SAM segmentation, face meshes and audio processing to replace characters and objects with Seedance, with a local web UI for preparing inputs, reviewing masks, previewing generations and exporting with original audio.

items.summary: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word written in pure Rust.

items.title_zh: trhhubsd/ARTEX：AI 自主渗透测试系统
items.summary: ARTEX is an AI autonomous penetration-testing system built with multi-agent LLMs in Go and Next.js; its description says it won Baidu's agent+ attack-and-defense challenge.

items.title: storytold/figcraft
items.title_zh: storytold/figcraft：纯 Rust 的协作界面设计工具
items.summary: FigCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of collaborative design workflows for interface design and prototyping, written in pure Rust.

items.title: shaongitbd/doory
items.title_zh: doory：开源 Canva 替代品
items.summary: Doory is an open-source design tool positioned as a Canva alternative, written in TypeScript.

items.title: onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent
items.title_zh: esp32-iphone-agent：用 7 美元 ESP32 让 AI 操控真实 iPhone
items.summary: The project lets an AI model operate a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32, using AirPlay for vision and USB HID for input. It works with any OpenAI-compatible vision model and requires no Mac, developer account or jailbreak.

items.title: liseami/CCBaga
items.title_zh: liseami/CCBaga
items.summary: CCBaga is a Rust-language GitHub repository; the trending listing provides no further description.

items.title: Deploying RDMA for Distributed Inference and Training At Scale
items.title_zh: 大规模分布式推理与训练中的 RDMA 部署
items.summary: ByteDance reports on deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA, in its parameter-server inference and training systems. It reduces mean and P99 model-parameter fetch latency in inference by 35.7% and 43.7%, and P99 push latency in training by up to 74.0%, compared with kernel TCP.

items.title: Sparse-TD-JEPA: Improving Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning With Sparse Latent Task Representations
items.title_zh: Sparse-TD-JEPA：用稀疏潜在任务表示改进零样本强化学习
items.summary: The paper introduces Sparse-TD-JEPA, which adds an L1 sparsity penalty to the task encoder of TD-JEPA so that reward-predictive structure concentrates in a smaller latent subspace; the change is applied only in training. Across 65 tasks on DeepMind Control and OGBench, it improved on TD-JEPA in all 13 domain-level comparisons, raising DMC average return from 661 to 714 and OGBench average success from 38.0% to 48.4%.

items.title: Activation Denoising: A Robustness View on Parallel vs Sequential LLM Quantization
items.title_zh: 激活去噪：从鲁棒性视角看并行与串行 LLM 量化
items.summary: The paper proposes parallel post-training quantization with activation denoising, treating upstream quantization error as noise and regularizing each layer against it, to recover much of sequential quantization's benefit while keeping quantization fully parallel.

items.title: CurveTQ: Rotation-Free Trellis Quantization of LLM Weights via Curvature-Weighted Search
items.title_zh: CurveTQ：基于曲率加权搜索的无旋转网格量化
items.summary: CurveTQ is a trellis quantization codec for LLM weights that puts the diagonal of the layer Hessian's LDL factorization into the Viterbi branch metric, avoiding the random rotations used by QTIP and Proteus. At two bits it reports 1-3 points higher mean downstream accuracy than both on three 4-8B instruct models and also leads on a 35B mixture-of-experts model, with the fastest decoder of the three at all tested batch sizes and bit widths.

items.title: Region-Aware CLS Token Augmentation for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval
items.title_zh: 面向细粒度图像检索的区域感知 CLS Token 增强
items.summary: The work augments the [CLS] token and register tokens of DINOv2-reg with automatically selected spatial patch regions, then applies a ColBERT-inspired multi-vector retrieval scheme. Experiments show that register tokens carry useful fine-grained detail and that the pooled ROI tokens improve discrimination while keeping storage tractable.

items.title: HarnessNet: Feedback-driven Hierarchical Joint Harness Evolution for Multi-agent Systems
items.title_zh: HarnessNet：多智能体系统的反馈驱动分层 harness 演化
items.summary: HarnessNet decomposes joint harness evolution in multi-agent systems into layered Agentron units with local optimizers that see only their own harness; on AgentBench it matches a single global optimizer with fewer tokens and less time, and the evolved harnesses transfer when foundation models are swapped.

items.title: Unfair and Unsafe: Everyday Bias Triggers Emergent Misalignment
items.title_zh: 不公平且不安全：日常偏见会触发涌现性失配
items.summary: The authors find that fine-tuning models on polite answers that rely on demographic stereotypes makes them less safe and less truthful on unrelated tasks, across four open-weight model families from 7B to 12B parameters. The learned stereotype has a distinct direction in model activations that can be used to monitor its acquisition, while existing defenses improve safety but leave the stereotype largely intact.
